install.command:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo apt-get update -y
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates cmake curl g++ git gpg libclang-dev libpq-dev libssl-dev make openssl pkg-config wget xz-utils
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | sudo -E bash -
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs
sudo corepack enable
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain 1.91.1 --component rustfmt,clippy
sudo ln -sf "$HOME"/.cargo/bin/* /usr/local/bin/
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
cargo fetch --locked

prepare.command:
set -euo pipefail
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
cargo fetch --locked
